parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a modern library or bookstore. The library has a high ceiling with large circular lights hanging from it. The walls are covered in bookshelves filled with books of different sizes and colors. On the right side of the image, there is a tall spiral staircase with multiple levels. In the center of the staircase, there are several orange chairs and tables with people sitting at them. The floor is made of marble tiles and there are plants scattered throughout the space. The overall atmosphere of the library is bright and inviting.
